content.title: General Mills and Lennar earnings, Google Gemini 3: Top Stories
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including General Mills (GIS) publishing its fiscal second quarter earnings results, homebuilder Lennar (LEN) disappointing on its earnings results and home order forecasts, and Alphabet's Google (GOOG, GOOGL) releasing a more affordable version of its Gemini 3 AI chatbot.
